GENERATE BURST VF-prim-ice-puff-01 — painted primitive S-ice ANGULAR PUFF — a bounded burst of ice crystals / frost breath for the ICE treatment (Run C-5, E2: fire × ice, one language; architecture 03- § 2.3 build list). task_id "VF-prim-ice-puff-01". One primitive per call. Paint the SHAPE REPRESENTING EMISSION only — light, glow, colour and motion are runtime layers.

IMAGE 1 is the SCALE + REGISTER board: a 1:1 native 512×512 crop of the painted cliffside clearing at the game camera with two figures 130 px tall (= 1 BH) beside a 3× enlargement; everything is hand-drawn painted 2D — confident dark contour with taper, clean painted planes, restrained texture. IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED FIRE impact peak (Matt-accepted): NOT the shape to copy — the LANGUAGE to match: exactly four flat greyscale value planes (near-black contour/rim, dark, light, white), hard plane edges, hand-drawn contour, no gradients or glow. Ice must speak the same language with a different vocabulary: FACETS instead of tongues — straight-edged, angular, crystalline planes; sharp points; no curls. IMAGE 3 is the native ground crop alone (reading only).

Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, 512×512, GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (RGBA: alpha 0 outside the body, opaque inside, no soft fringe wider than 1 px) — if transparency is impossible, a flat uniform #00ff00 plate and SAY SO. Content: an ANGULAR PUFF of frost: a bounded cluster of small pointed crystal facets and flakes packed into an irregular polygonal mass (no soft cloud edge — every edge is a facet), denser at the lower-left, thinning to scattered points at the upper-right; hand-drawn dark contour with taper. PAINTED EXTENT: about 150 px across (1.15 BH) and about 130 px tall; centred; nothing touches the canvas edge. Same camera as IMAGE 1 (an upright body facing the camera; no ground squash). VALUE-INDEX ENCODING: GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FOUR flat value planes with hard edges (plane 0 near-black = contour + a thin dark rim; plane 1 dark grey = shadowed facets; plane 2 light grey = lit facets, most of the body; plane 3 white = the brightest edge highlights and the densest core, no more than a fifth of the body), no gradients, glow, blur, texture or colour; one frame of hand-drawn 2D effects animation at the scene's line weight. No ground, shadow, sparkles, mist, motion blur, character or text.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if: the background is not clean, there are gradients/glow/soft edges or more than four value planes, the body touches the canvas edge, the extent is off by more than 25 %, or the vocabulary is wrong (rounded/organic shapes, curls, a symmetric snowflake) — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ice_puff_01.png with sha256 (no conversion, no trim, no keying). No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "VF-prim-ice-puff-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/ice_puff_01.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly (state whether the output has real transparency).

references.role: IMAGE 2 — the approved fire peak: the LANGUAGE (four planes, hand-drawn contour), not the shape
